label: Climate Hazard
description: Projected change in climate hazard by mid- and late century (SSP2-4.5), from six individual INDRA-CMIP6 models, following Rama Rao et al. (2020).

label: Exposure
description: Inventory of rural people and agriculture-dependent livelihoods that could be adversely affected by climate change impacts.

label: Vulnerability
description: Sensitivity (factors increasing susceptibility, including projected crop yield impacts) and adaptive capacity (factors enabling adjustment) of agriculture-dependent communities.

label: Risk Score
description: Composite district-level climate risk classification (Very High to Very Low) combining hazard, exposure and vulnerability following the IPCC WG2 risk framework.
